question_intent: Host wants a history of the Iranian Red Lion and Sun Society: how its work began, and the historical arc through to what happened later.
complete_question_core: سؤال اول این است که یک تاریخچه‌ای از جمعیت شیر و خورشید سرخ ایران بدانیم که فعالیتش را چطور شروع می‌کند و این سیر تاریخی را بررسی کنیم تا برسیم به اتفاقات امروز.
main_answer: The guest answers by starting from the international Red Cross at Solferino 1863, then says Muslim states rejected the cross and Iran requested its own emblem from the lion-and-sun flag; the Iranian body was inactive under the Qajars until 1301 statutes, grew as a health/relief institution under Reza Shah, and after 1357 was confiscated into the Red Crescent.
required_reasoning: Must begin from the global Red Cross, not jump straight to Iran.
Muslim countries would not accept a Christian cross; Iran asked for its own emblem.
Qajar-era inactivity, then official founding around 1301.
Pahlavi-era health infrastructure (hospitals, nursing, army medical services) as what the society actually did.
1357 / confiscation as the arrival at 'today's events'.
required_context: New viewer needs the name جمعیت شیر و خورشید سرخ ایران.
Needs to know the lion-and-sun came from Iran's flag as a requested national emblem.
Needs to know the later body is the Red Crescent after confiscation.
qualifications: Guest's historical telling, not an independent archival ruling.
Confiscation is presented as the guest's account (Khomeini decree / 10 Tir).
conclusion_payoff: After 1357 the unique Iranian emblem/society is confiscated and falls into the Islamic Republic Red Crescent.

dependencies.needs: the international emblem is a cross / Red Cross origin

that this unique Iranian body/emblem existed
